question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
crosswordDirections: Type one letter in each white square. The arrow keys move between squares. Select a square again, or press Space, to switch between across and down. Select a clue to jump to its word. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}.
startHint: Select a square or a clue to begin.
noWords: This crossword has no words yet.
addWords: Add words and clues in the settings to build the crossword. The grid is made for you.
answerKey: Answer key. Learners never see these letters.
unplacedHeading: Words left out of the grid
unplacedHelp: These words could not be placed, so learners will not see them. Change a word so it shares a letter with another word, or remove it.
reasonLimit: is past the limit of {max} words
reasonNofit: shares no usable letter with the grid
